assertion.zh: 在稳态自由流条件下，向 3 车 HV 车队中插入一辆 AV（构成 HV–AV–HV）可使车队聚合跟驰风险(TTC<1.5s 发生率)相对全 HV 车队降低至少 20%。
assertion.en: Under steady free-flow conditions, inserting a single AV into a 3-vehicle HV platoon (forming HV–AV–HV) reduces the platoon's aggregate car-following risk (TTC<1.5s rate) by at least 20% relative to a homogeneous all-HV platoon.

prediction.zh: 在固定随机种子(20260909)的确定性模拟中，全 HV 基线车队的 TTC<1.5s 发生率应高于 HV–AV–HV 自适应变体的发生率，且降幅 ≥ 20%。
prediction.en: In the deterministic simulation with fixed seed 20260909, the all-HV baseline platoon's TTC<1.5s rate shall exceed the HV–AV–HV adaptive variant's rate by at least 20% (relative reduction).

falsification.condition: If the adaptive HV–AV–HV TTC<1.5s rate is NOT lower than the all-HV baseline rate by at least 20% (i.e. (baseline-adaptive)/baseline < 0.20), the claim is falsified.
falsification.scope: Claim is scoped to steady free-flow; stop-and-go boundary (see boundary-counterexample.json) is explicitly excluded and may break it.

disclaimer: FIXTURE falsifiable claim. Numbers used for falsification are MOCK deterministic values in mock-experiment.json; this is not a real empirical finding.
